title: QR Creation - QR Code Generator
short_description: Create stunning QR codes — Standard, Micro, Custom, Holographic, and 3D styles.
full_description:
QR Creation is the ultimate QR code generator with 6 unique code types:

▸ Standard — Classic QR codes with high reliability
▸ Micro — Compact codes for small spaces
▸ Compact — Optimized data encoding
▸ Custom — Styled dot patterns (square, rounded, circle, diamond)
▸ Holographic — Beautiful gradient color effects
▸ 3D Cube — QR codes rendered on 3D cube faces

Features:
• Customize dot styles, corner patterns, and colors
• Brand-matched gradient presets
• Download as SVG or PNG
• Share directly to any app
• Scan QR codes with your camera
• Works offline for basic generation

Perfect for businesses, marketers, designers, and anyone who needs professional QR codes.

Built by Omega UI, LLC
